## **1\. Purpose**

**Shown when:** the car owner has a verified vehicle report and chooses to sell the car. The screen shows the verified vehicle data and the legal status automatically updated, and collects the current mileage, the desired price and the phone number to create the sale request.

**The user leaves this screen when:** the car owner goes back with the Back arrow of the Top bar, or the sale request has been sent.

## **4\. States**

| State | What the user sees | Trigger |
| ----- | ----- | ----- |
| Default | Vehicle card (4 to 7\) and legal card (9 to 11\) filled; the 3 textboxes filled with example values (14, 17, 20\) with their hints (15, 18, 21); button "Gửi yêu cầu bán xe" (22) active. | Screen opened and the form is filled by the car owner |
| Empty | Same cards. The 3 textboxes show their placeholders and the hints; button (22) active. | Screen opened and the car owner has not entered anything |
| Loading | Banner (23) at the top; legal status values (9 to 11\) show "—"; the 3 textboxes keep the entered values; button (22) shows "Đang gửi yêu cầu…" and is inactive. The banner disappears when the request has been processed. | The car owner taps (22) and the form passes the validation: the system re-checks the legal status and creates the request (FR-03-01, FR-03-02) |
| Error, validation (FE) | Invalid textboxes have a red border and an inline error text instead of the hint (15, 18, 21). No popup, nothing is sent. Button (22) stays active. | The car owner taps (22) and at least one textbox is empty or invalid (section 3, Validation column) |
| Error, system (BE or API) | Error popup (24 to 27\) with warning icon, message, button "Thử lại" and button "Đóng" (and X). Behind it the form keeps the entered values. | The system could not create the request or send it, or the report has not been initialized for the VIN (FR-03-01) |
| Success | Success popup (24, 25, 27\) with check icon, message and button "Đóng" (and X). Behind it the form keeps the entered values. | The sale request has been created, the legal status re-check has been attached and the package has been forwarded (FR-03-01, FR-03-02, FR-03-03) |

## **5\. Interactions and navigation**

| \# | Element | User action | System response | Goes to screen |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| 1 | Back (1) | tap | Returns without sending the request | S-F01-02 (see open question 5\) |
| 2 | Current mileage, Desired price, Phone number (14, 17, 20\) | type | The textbox shows the typed value; the hint (15, 18, 21\) stays until the car owner taps (22) | stays |
| 3 | Submit (22) | tap | Validates the 3 textboxes. If one is invalid, shows the Error (validation) state and sends nothing. If all are valid, shows the Loading state, re-checks the legal status, creates the request and forwards it to Carpla staff | stays (loading, then success or error) |
| 4 | Retry (26) | tap (error popup) | Closes the popup, shows the Loading state and sends the request again | stays (loading, then success or error) |
| 5 | Close (27) | tap (error or success popup) | Closes the popup. After an error the form keeps the entered values; after a success see open question 1 | stays |
| 6 | Close popup (25) | tap (error or success popup) | Same as Close (27) | stays |

## **6\. Screen-level rules**

| Rule ID | Rule | Source |
| ----- | ----- | ----- |
| SR-001 | The screen shows the verified vehicle data and the legal status as read-only, and collects the current mileage, the desired price and the phone number to create one sale request. | FR-03-01 |
| SR-002 | The request is created only for a vehicle whose report has been initialized for its VIN. Otherwise the system rejects the request and shows the error popup. | FR-03-01 |
| SR-003 | The form is validated before sending. An invalid textbox shows a red border and an inline error text under it; no popup is used and nothing is sent. | FR-03-01-FE, ui-conventions §4 |
| SR-004 | When the request is submitted, the system re-checks the legal status with the three portals and attaches the results. If a portal has no record or does not respond, that check is attached as "No data" and the request is still forwarded. | FR-03-02 |
| SR-005 | While the request is processed, the button is inactive and shows "Đang gửi yêu cầu…" so the request cannot be sent twice. The banner has no button and disappears when processing ends. | FR-03-01-FE, ui-conventions §4 |
| SR-006 | A system error is shown as a popup with the buttons "Thử lại" and "Đóng". A success popup has one button "Đóng". While a popup is open, the controls behind it cannot be used. A popup is never used for navigation. | ui-conventions §3, §4 |
| SR-007 | Formats: mileage `45.500 km`; price `850.000.000 ₫`; phone `0901 234 567` (10 digits, starts with 0). | ui-conventions §2 |
| SR-008 | The package forwarded to Carpla staff contains the verified report and the latest market price; if no market price exists, the price is marked as unavailable. This is done in the background and is not shown on this screen. | FR-03-03 |

## **8\. Responsive and accessibility notes**

* Smallest supported width: 360px, single column, vertical scroll only; no horizontal scroll.  
* Information is never carried by colour alone: legal status badges have an icon and text; error textboxes have a red border and an error text; popups have an icon and text.  
* Text contrast at least 4.5:1; body text at least 14 px; layout must not break when the system font is enlarged.  
* Tap targets at least 44 x 44 px: Back arrow (1), the 3 textboxes (14, 17, 20), Submit (22), popup X (25), "Thử lại" (26), "Đóng" (27).  
* The loading banner and the popups must be readable by a screen reader (loading icon, warning icon and check icon have a text alternative). Inline error texts are linked to their textbox.  
* The numeric textboxes open a numeric keyboard on mobile.
